## EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT CHEF ZAC YOUNG’S CHRISTMAS PIECAKEN


PieCaken Bakeshop’s Christmas PieCaken


The Christmas PieCaken is a three-layer holiday dessert by pastry chef Zac Young that stacks chocolate pecan pie, cherry swirl cheesecake, and red velvet cake into one cake. It’s frosted with cream cheese buttercream and finished with festive red and white sprinkles. It’s the Christmas version of the Original PieCaken, Young’s famous Thanksgiving dessert of pecan pie, pumpkin pie, and spice cake. Each Christmas PieCaken weighs about 6 pounds, serves 10–12, and ships nationwide exclusively on Goldbelly.


**Christmas PieCaken at a glance**


- **Layers, bottom to top:** chocolate pecan pie, cherry swirl cheesecake, and red velvet cake
- **Frosting:** cream cheese buttercream
- **Topping:** red and white sprinkles
- **Created by:** pastry chef Zac Young, PieCaken Bakeshop, New York City
- **Size:** about 6 lb, 7 × 5 inches, serves 10–12
- **How it ships:** frozen with dry ice; keeps in the freezer for up to 3 months
- **Price:** $109.95 on Goldbelly


## **What’s inside the Christmas PieCaken?**


Every slice cuts through all three layers:


1. **Chocolate pecan pie:** gooey and crunchy, with toasted pecans and chocolate
2. **Cherry swirl cheesecake:** creamy and tangy, with ribbons of cherry
3. **Red velvet cake:** soft, tender, and lightly chocolatey


Cream cheese buttercream holds the layers together and covers the outside, and red and white sprinkles finish it off.


## **What is a PieCaken?**


A PieCaken is a dessert that stacks pie and cake into one. Pastry chef Zac Young created the Original PieCaken in 2015 with pastry chef Gian Martinez at David Burke Fabrick in New York City as the dessert version of a turducken. It layers pecan pie, pumpkin pie, and spice cake with cinnamon buttercream and apple pie filling. After the PieCaken went viral, Young started shipping it nationwide and began making seasonal versions for other holidays, including Christmas.


**Read More:**[What is PieCaken and Where to Buy It?](https://blog.goldbelly.com/what-is-piecaken/)


## **History of the Christmas PieCaken**


The PieCaken started out as a fun dessert to compete with turducken. The turducken is a trio of Thanksgiving meats that rival traditional turkey. Chef Zac Young was working at a restaurant in New York City that was set to serve turducken. Turducken is a chicken inside a duck inside a turkey.


He created a cake and pie dessert that features three desserts in one: pecan pie, pumpkin pie, and spice cake. The Original PieCaken is frosted with cinnamon buttercream and topped with apple pie filling. What was meant to be a limited offering turned into a social media frenzy and bakery business devoted to making one of the world’s most unique desserts.


The winter-themed Christmas PieCaken was created after the Thanksgiving-themed Original PieCaken.


## **Where can you buy the Christmas PieCaken?**


The Christmas PieCaken is baked in New York City by Zac Young’s PieCaken Bakeshop and ships nationwide exclusively on Goldbelly.


**[The Christmas PieCaken](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-piecaken-shop/the-goldbelly-christmas-piecaken)** is a festive, multi-layered dessert featuring rich Chocolate Pecan Pie, creamy Eggnog Cheesecake, and moist Red Velvet Cake. Each layer is stacked together and finished with smooth Amaretto Buttercream, then topped with bright Cherry Pie Filling. Red and green holiday sprinkles add the perfect seasonal touch.


If you’re celebrating a different holiday, there’s also a special PieCaken for Passover. **[The PassCaken](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-piecaken-shop/the-passcaken)** includes three delicious layers: matzo-crusted coconut macaroon pie, flourless chocolate cake, and a light raspberry mousse. It’s finished with a chocolate and sea salt matzo crumble for the perfect sweet-and-salty crunch.
